name: Persona
tagline: Community app where groups chat, post and run a shared treasury with proposals and votes
role: React Native development by the Softwhere team for Persona, New York

scenes.title: Communities that build together
scenes.body: The app's own welcome screen: a social network paired with group funds its members govern.

scenes.title: Every community in one rail
scenes.body: A side rail switches communities; each lists its channels with unread badges and the shared balance.

scenes.title: Real-time chat for every channel
scenes.body: Messages stream from Firestore, grouped by author, with emoji reactions and image attachments.

scenes.title: Proposals the group votes on
scenes.body: Treasury proposals tally for, against and abstain votes with a quorum and a countdown to the deadline.

scenes.title: A shared treasury, fully tracked
scenes.body: Deposits and withdrawals land in a transfers feed; the portfolio shows available and pending funds.
